mapper.select: SELECT record_version,task_id,step_id,binding_digest,upper_seq,input_digest,target_seq,relation_policy,content_state,outcome,failure_code,output_digest,output_bytes,receipt_event_seq,committed_attempt_id,committed_fence FROM invocation_session_trace WHERE tenant_id=#{tenant} AND invocation_id=#{invocation} FOR UPDATE
mapper.update: UPDATE invocation_session_trace SET outcome=#{commit.outcome},failure_code=#{commit.code},scan_digest=#{commit.scanDigest},relations_digest=#{commit.relationsDigest},target_digest=#{commit.targetDigest},scan_rows=#{commit.rows},scan_event_bytes=#{commit.eventBytes},relation_edges=#{commit.edges},output_digest=#{commit.outputDigest},output_bytes=#{commit.outputBytes},receipt_event_seq=#{commit.receipt},committed_attempt_id=#{attempt},committed_fence=#{fence},committed_at=CURRENT_TIMESTAMP(6) WHERE tenant_id=#{tenant} AND invocation_id=#{invocation} AND outcome='PENDING'
